Subject: Post-call recap + request to schedule VP/CTO intro (to unblock pilot)

Hi Jordan — great conversation earlier, thanks for walking through the current infra and the priority POC success criteria. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can unblock scheduling with your exec team: 

Summary (from our discovery)
- Goal: 8k convs/day inference within 120ms p95 for critical API (ingestion -> response).
- Constraints: must run in us-west region, strict data residency, SOC2+ audit windows.
- Success metric for pilot: end-to-end latency < 150ms p95 and cost < $0.002/token for 30-day run.

Immediate asks
1) Exec alignment: can we get a 30–40 min intro between your VP of Engineering or CTO and our Head of Product / Ben? Purpose: unblock the timeline and confirm security gating items.
2) Technical deep dive: follow-on 60m with infra + runtime team to map exact integration points.
3) Share SOW draft and multi-account architecture map (attached).

Proposed exec windows (please pick one):
- Wed Jun 24 — 11:00–11:40 PT
- Thu Jun 25 — 14:00–14:40 PT
- Fri Jun 26 — 09:30–10:10 PT

Attached: CardinalTech-MAP.pdf (high-level infra map), SOW-draft-v1.docx (baseline).

If none of those work, tell me a few slots that do and I’ll lock it from our side. We’ll keep the exec call light — agenda: 1) 10m goals/pilot timeline, 2) 15m security & compliance gating, 3) 10m next steps / ownership.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
